capabilities.rationale: Human trace texts ht-02/ht-03/ht-16/ht-17/ht-23 require registration, sign-in, and a persistent member identity. Directly observed: /login panel (username-or-email + password + Google/Apple IdP), /signup onboarding questionnaire ending in account creation, and the authenticated /my-jefit member area. Clone accounts persist in this site's own SQLite via the websitebench.site_backend seam.

ht-18 requires the Forgot Password recovery view (reset-address field, validation guidance, return-to-sign-in) without sending a reset message. Directly observed 'Forgot Password?' link on the login panel. Clone implements the recovery flow against the seam with mail confined to the local outbox.

Directly observed: settings Account tab shows 'Unverified' email state with 'Resend Verification Link'; recovery flow implies reset mail. Clone models verification and recovery mail via seam purposes; real delivery stays disabled (REAL_EMAIL_AUTHORIZED=false), local outbox only in offline profiles.

Task 539 (ht-02/ht-23) creates an Elite Annual subscription order. Directly observed: in-app plan modal, /elite/checkout?sub={monthly,yearly} routes, Stripe-hosted checkout with coupon 25%OffFirstYear, and the /my-jefit/settings Account destination view where membership state must appear. The clone records the subscription order in its own SQLite in the same transaction as payment consumption.

The Elite upgrade checkout flow (plan selection -> checkout page -> confirmation -> settings destination view, plus cancel/back returning to /my-jefit/settings) is the P0 journey. The clone serves a clone-local checkout continuation; source evidence for the page comes from the captured Stripe-hosted checkout states.

Payment uses the local-sandbox adapter exclusively with deterministic approved/declined/retryable scenarios accepted as opaque scenario IDs only. Card numbers, CVV, expiry, bank or wallet credentials are never accepted or stored; stripe-test is not requested (STRIPE_TEST_AUTHORIZED=false) and live payment is prohibited.

Member business entities require persistence: custom routines with exercises/sets/reps/rest/order, workout session logs, progress/body metrics, goals and training preferences, notification settings, membership state, and the public exercise/routine catalog fixtures. All live in this site's exclusive SQLite reached through the generated integration seam.
